title: Conormal sheaf of the diagonal and relative differentials
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let \Delta:X\to X\times_S X be its diagonal [def-pc-base-change] with ideal sheaf \mathcal I [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let C_\Delta=\Delta^*(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2) be the conormal sheaf [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then there is a canonical isomorphism C_\Delta\cong\Omega^1_{X/S} [def-sc-kahler-differentials].

source.place: Tag 08S2 (conormal sheaf of the diagonal is the sheaf of relative differentials)
